create_HelloRequest: create a HelloRequest protobuf message with a name field for gRPC calls
create_HelloReply: create a HelloReply protobuf message with a message field for gRPC responses
use_Greeter_service: use the Greeter service descriptor to define a SayHello RPC method
inspect_DESCRIPTOR: inspect the helloworld.proto file descriptor to list message types and services
register_sym_db: register the HelloRequest and HelloReply messages in the protobuf symbol database
